name: classvr-prototypes
description: Plugins for building WebXR prototypes for ClassVR headsets without a terminal.

plugins.name: classvr-prototyping-kit
plugins.description: Create a working WebXR scene in Claude Cowork, publish it to a permanent Vercel link that opens on a ClassVR headset from its own QR code, keep every version, and copy someone else's prototype from its address — no terminal, no libraries to install.
